from sympy import sin, symbols
from sympy.strategies.core import identity
from sympy.strategies.traverse import bottom_up


class TestStrategiesBottomUpMaxCallDepthQA:
    def test_strategies_bottom_up_max_call_depth_case(self):
        x = symbols("x")

        expr = x
        for _ in range(16):
            expr = sin(expr)

        rewritten = bottom_up(identity)(expr)

        assert rewritten == expr

26	def sall(rule, fns=basic_fns):
27	    """Strategic all - apply rule to args."""
28	    op, new, children, leaf = map(fns.get, ('op', 'new', 'children', 'leaf'))
29

31	        if leaf(expr):
32	            return expr
33	        else:
34	            args = map(rule, children(expr))
35	            return new(op(expr), *args)

1	""" Generic SymPy-Independent Strategies """
2	from __future__ import annotations
3	from collections.abc import Callable, Mapping
4	from typing import TypeVar
5	from sys import stdout

9	_T = TypeVar('_T')

12	def identity(x: _T) -> _T:
13	    return x

16	def exhaust(rule: Callable[[_T], _T]) -> Callable[[_T], _T]:
17	    """ Apply a rule repeatedly until it has no effect """
18	    def exhaustive_rl(expr: _T) -> _T:
19	        new, old = rule(expr), expr
20	        while new != old:
21	            new, old = rule(new), new
22	        return new
23	    return exhaustive_rl

26	def memoize(rule: Callable[[_S], _T]) -> Callable[[_S], _T]:
27	    """Memoized version of a rule
28	
29	    Notes
30	    =====
31	
32	    This cache can grow infinitely, so it is not recommended to use this
33	    than ``functools.lru_cache`` unless you need very heavy computation.
34	    """
35	    cache: dict[_S, _T] = {}
36	
37	    def memoized_rl(expr: _S) -> _T:
38	        if expr in cache:
39	            return cache[expr]
40	        else:
41	            result = rule(expr)
42	            cache[expr] = result
43	            return result
44	    return memoized_rl

48	    cond: Callable[[_T], bool], rule: Callable[[_T], _T]
49	) -> Callable[[_T], _T]:
50	    """ Only apply rule if condition is true """
51	    def conditioned_rl(expr: _T) -> _T:
52	        if cond(expr):
53	            return rule(expr)
54	        return expr
55	    return conditioned_rl

60	    Compose a sequence of rules so that they apply to the expr sequentially
61	    """

63	        for rule in rules:

95	    """ Return original expr if rule raises exception """

105	    """ Try each of the rules until one works. Then stop. """
106	    def do_one_rl(expr: _T) -> _T:

117	    ruledict: Mapping[_T, Callable[[_S], _S]]
118	) -> Callable[[_S], _S]:
119	    """ Select a rule based on the result of key called on the function """

134	    objective=_identity
135	) -> Callable[[_S], _T]:
136	    """ Select result of rules that minimizes objective
137	
138	    >>> from sympy.strategies import minimize
139	    >>> inc = lambda x: x + 1
140	    >>> dec = lambda x: x - 1
141	    >>> rl = minimize(inc, dec)
142	    >>> rl(4)
143	    3
144	
145	    >>> rl = minimize(inc, dec, objective=lambda x: -x)  # maximize
146	    >>> rl(4)
147	    5
148	    """
149	    def minrule(expr: _S) -> _T:
150	        return min([rule(expr) for rule in rules], key=objective)
